title: GPT-5 vs Claude: Which AI Model Should You Use in 2026?
summary: GPT-5 or Claude Opus 4.6? Verified benchmark scores, current API pricing, and an honest breakdown of which model wins for coding, reasoning, and everyday use in 2026.
body_markdown: It depends on the task. GPT-5 wins on price (4x cheaper input tokens), multimodal breadth (text, vision, and audio), and broad benchmark performance across general tasks. Claude Opus 4.6 wins on SWE-bench coding scores, long context (1M tokens), and collaborative reasoning quality. Neither model is universally better — they have genuinely different strengths suited to different workloads.
